title: The notice board/hunter's tally pointed to a 'sunken shrine' and 'old watchtower' verse location within the Vale of Ash, but after ~100 turns of searching the Vale and adjacent Fenmarch I never found either; status kept listing them as 'unexplored' even after Act I was fully completed via crown-return instead.
